'''Pharl McQuarrie''' was a [[human]] from the [[planet]] [[Ralltiir]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars]] as a prominent military [[advisor]]. He later served as a [[general]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] and his work aided in the [[Battle of Scarif|retrieval]] of the [[Death Star plans]]. With his knowledge of planning and logistics, McQuarrie played a key role in planning the Alliance's headquarters on the planet [[Hoth]], named [[Echo Base]], and headed its construction before being selected as General [[Carlist Rieekan]]'s second-in-command.

In [[3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire]] discovered the Alliance's presence on Hoth and deployed [[Blizzard Force|forces]] to [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] Echo Base. McQuarrie was instrumental in coordinating a defensive action against the Empire that allowed the vast majority of the base's personnel and equipment to be evacuated to a rallying point.

==Biography==
===Building Echo Base===
[[File:Echo-Base-cutaway-SWCL.png|thumb|right|300px|Pharl McQuarrie played a vital role in the construction of Echo Base.]]
A [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[Ralltiir]], Pharl McQuarrie fought in the [[Clone Wars]] as a prominent military [[advisor]]<ref name="Altaya" /> and later came to serve as a [[general]] in the [[Alliance Army|army]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Updated and Expanded" /> It was in part through his efforts for the Alliance that the [[Death Star plans]] were retrieved by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]<ref name="Altaya" /> following their recovery on the planet [[Scarif]] following the [[Battle of Scarif]]<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

After the plans were used to destroy the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> he<ref name="Altaya" /> played an integral part in the planning and establishment of [[Echo Base]],<ref name="Bust" /> the Alliance's headquarters on the [[Water|icy]] planet [[Hoth]],<ref name="Updated and Expanded" /> and was personally selected to head up its construction, in which he proved instrumental,<ref name="Bust" /> overseeing everything from the fundamental structure to the equipment installation.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rebel Alliance}}</ref> It took eighteen [[Standard month|months]] to construct the base, two of which were simply installing the equipment.<ref name="Helmets">{{HelmetCollectionCite|32|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> After the base's completion,<ref name="Bust" /> the [[Commanding officer|commander]] of Echo Base,<ref name="Updated and Expanded" /> [[Alliance officer|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]], selected McQuarrie to be his second-in-command<ref name="Bust" /> based on his contribution to the base.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===The Battle of Hoth===
[[File:PharlMcQuarrie-ESB.jpg|thumb|left|310px|McQuarrie was instrumental in the construction and defense of Echo Base.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> less than a month after the Alliance had begun using Echo Base,<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> an Imperial [[XJ9-CS14|Viper probe droid]] discovered it and alerted the Empire. After locating and destroying the [[Viper probe droid|droid]], the Alliance began to evacuate immediately. During the preparations, McQuarrie strode across one of the base's [[hangar]]s past several other base personnel.<ref name="ESB" />

Before the evacuation could begin, an [[Death Squadron|Imperial fleet]] arrived in the [[Hoth system]] and deployed [[Blizzard Force|ground forces]] to [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] Echo Base.<ref name="ESB" /> McQuarrie played a key role in coordinating a delaying defensive action against the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] and bought the Alliance [[time]] to evacuate the vast majority of the base's personnel and equipment to a rallying point,<ref name="Bust" /> including all members of [[Alliance High Command]] who were present.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Personality and traits==
McQuarrie's knowledge of planning and logistics made him integral during the planning and establishment of Echo Base. He was a [[human]] with fair skin, [[Color|white]] [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s.<ref name="Bust" />

==Equipment==
While stationed at Echo Base, McQuarrie wore a brown [[cold-weather issue command parka]], white [[command gauntlet]]s, a brown [[belt]], and a white [[insulated watch cap]] with a [[Comlink|com unit]], a [[Clothing|face wrap]],<ref name="Bust" /> [[Hat|cap]] warmers,<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> and green [[anti-glare goggles]].<ref name="Bust" /> He also carried a clipboard.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:McQuarrie-Ellenshaw-Pangrazio.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ralph McQuarrie, Harrison Ellenshaw, and Michael Pangrazio all had cameos in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
Pharl McQuarrie was created as an on-screen [[List of cameos in Star Wars|cameo]] for concept artist [[Ralph McQuarrie]]<ref name="Insider 134">{{InsiderCite|134|Ralph McQuarrie: Dreamer & Visionary}}</ref> in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> McQuarrie appears carrying his sketch clipboard<ref name="Insider 134" /> in front of a matte painting that he created in a scene that also includes several other concept artists who worked on the film cameoing as rebel personnel, including [[Joe Johnston]], [[Harrison Ellenshaw]], and [[Michael Pangrazio]].<ref name="McQuarrie interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ralphmcquarrie.com/sign/dvd/index.html|text=Ralph McQuarrie: Illustrator Exclusive DVD interview|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20051215144519/http://www.ralphmcquarrie.com/sign/dvd/index.html Ralph McQuarrie: Illustrator]|archivedate=20051215144519}}</ref> While Johnson was given a brief line of dialogue,<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> McQuarrie claimed the crew did not trust him with lines as they knew he would "flub" them.<ref name="McQuarrie interview" /> The scene was filmed as part of pickups at [[Industrial Light & Magic]] in [[Wikipedia:California|California]] on [[February 9]], 1980 and took ten takes to complete.<ref name="MakingOf" />

The name Pharl McQuarrie was first used in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] during the release of a bust of the character sold as a convention exclusive at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Bust" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the character was first identified as simply [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|McQuarrie]] on a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Special Edition Limited">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=General McQuarrie}}</ref> The first name "Pharl," an [[Tuckerization|anagram]] of Ralph, was then introduced in the [[2004]] article "[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|Who's Who in Echo Base]]," which was written by [[Josh Radke]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref>
